name: Giants
overview: The Bible records the existence of giants in the earth, notably described as mighty men and men of renown arising when the sons of God mingled with the daughters of men (Genesis 6:1,4). These giants, including the sons of Anak and the Emims, were known for their great size and strength, instilling fear among the Israelites as they surveyed the Promised Land (Numbers 13:33; Deuteronomy 1:28; 2:10-11). Scripture presents these giants as formidable inhabitants of the land, emphasizing both their physical stature and the challenges they posed to God's people.
